## Self-review checklist
<!-- Tick each box ONLY after you actually checked. Reviewing your own PR
     before merging is a real engineer habit — don't skip it. -->

- [ ] I ran `git diff` and read every changed line
- [ ] No leftover junk (stray tags, commented-out code, `console.log`)
- [ ] Commit messages follow `type: description` (feat/fix/style/chore/...)
- [ ] Each commit is one logical change (no "and" in the message)
- [ ] I opened the page and clicked through it — the feature actually works
- [ ] This branch does ONE task (see TASKS.md)
